profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Emerging SME | AI & Agent Development
profile.summary: Full-stack developer focused on application development and continuous improvement. Working towards being SME and expanding my experience in AI and agent development.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Developing and maintaining full-stack applications, new features, defect fixes, UI/UX improvements, and production ready code.
- Point of contact and emerging SME for the team’s primary application, supporting development decisions, troubleshooting, and application ownership.
- Lead and coordinated application deployments across SIT, DEV, and Production. Release readiness, and deployment support.
- Exploring AI engineering through AI agent development for my team and finding opportunities to automate repetitive development and team workflows
- Serving as a main developer on a cross team application initiative, contributing to requirements, thoughts on UI/UX decisions, technical implementation, and delegation of development work across the team.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Software Development and +12 skills

positions.title: Scheduling Coordinator
positions.description:
Responsible for managing and editing dental office schedules: scheduled, rescheduled or cancelled appointments properly. 
Demonstrated excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, able to interact with patients in a friendly manner. 
Deep understanding of the dental industry, procedures and practices. Able to manage patient billing and insurance records. 
Collaborated daily and closely with a large network of dental teams (Dallas, New Orleans, Chicago, Atlanta mint networks) to ensure a seamless patient experience.
positions.insights: Communication, Collaborative Problem Solving and +3 skills

positions.title: Summer Intern Technology Experience Center
positions.description:
Revised and updated the department website including adding a new map for reference and descriptions for products. 
Set up and tested new technology including the Dell Canvas and the Dell 43 multi-input monitor to educate employees. 
Presented 10 tours of the department to large groups of AT&T employees and interns. 
Tested and prepared 200 laptop docks and 50 workstation kits for readily use on Workplace 2020 floors at AT&T HQ. 
Inventoried past company cellular devices for recycling.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
